import requests
import subprocess
import time
async def operation():
    requests.get("https://example.org")
    subprocess.run(["echo","ok"])
    time.sleep(1)

import requests as r
from subprocess import run as launch
from time import sleep as snooze
async def operation():
    r.get("https://example.org")
    launch(["echo","ok"])
    snooze(1)

async def operation(requests,subprocess,time):
    requests.get("/local")
    subprocess.run(["noop"])
    time.sleep(1)

async def operation(x,y,z):
    x.get("/local")
    y.run(["noop"])
    z.sleep(1)
